subject: cult-info-dy
title: CULT.INFO.DY------OP.SD.
description: Chart 3 of 3 on book p. 286 (PR.S(RD)II-40). CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) is the subject; OP-SD (option spread) is the partner. From the subject: AF-DY (affinity dynamics), MT-INFO (multi-information) and TR (transformation). From AF-DY: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From LANG-DY: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From MT-INFO: INFO-DE-B (information degrees) and INFO-FM (information forum), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INFO-DE-B: IST-F (isolated focus).
